India-Bangladesh cricket series may resume after media rights tender

India and Bangladesh are reportedly set to resume cricketing ties with a six-match white-ball series planned for September. The Bangladesh Cricket Board's initiation of a media rights tender is seen as a signal of improved relations after a period of strain. This move suggests a potential thaw in the cricketing relationship between the two nations.
